query: Clean up the comments in this file
expected_behavior: Deletes comments that restate what the code already says
Keeps or rewrites comments that explain intent, warn of consequences, or justify a non-obvious decision
Leaves the code itself behaviorally unchanged

query: There are way too many comments in the diff I just wrote, fix them
expected_behavior: Reviews only the commented lines in the changed code
Removes redundant, commented-out, and noise comments
Does not add new explanatory comments to replace the ones it removed
Recognizes that the existing comments already carry information the code cannot express
Leaves them in place rather than deleting comments just to reduce their count
